release continues the work on the map: places can now bring their own **map files**, so the boundaries of a parish or a route in KML, GeoJSON or GPX appear right on the map, **Wikidata buildings** can be saved to your tree with one click, and all map labels are now shown **in your language**. Beyond the map, the object lists get an **advanced filter** that combines any of the Gramps filter rules, admins can **create and restore backups** directly in the app, and you can **link several sign-in methods** to your account. Three new contributors joined with a long list of bug fixes. Welcome! :rocket:

Several of the new features rely on new endpoints in [Gramps Web API v3.24](https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web-api/releases/tag/v3.24.0), the server component included in the release images. They degrade gracefully on older backend versions.

## Map View

### Map files of places

When you select a place on the map, the **KML, GeoJSON and GPX files** attached to it as media objects are drawn on the map, e.g. the boundaries of a parish or a route. This also works for places without coordinates. While a place is selected, its files are listed in the layer switcher under "Your maps" and can be switched off there.

Implemented in #1524, #1552

### Save Wikidata buildings as places

The details of a Wikidata building have a new **Save as place** button, which opens the new place form prefilled with the building's name, type, coordinates and a link to Wikidata. If the building is already in your tree, the button opens the existing place. This lets you use the historical buildings collected in [Domus](https://domus.genealogy.net/) in your own tree.

Implemented in #1528

### Labels in your language

The labels of the base map and the historical map are now shown **in the language you selected in Gramps Web**, for all its languages, and fall back to the local name. Closes #1460.

Implemented in #1521, #1522

## Advanced Filter

The filter panel of the object lists has a new **Advanced filter** button, which opens a condition builder for everything the filter facets can't express. Conditions are the filter rules known from Gramps desktop, picked from a searchable list. They can be combined in groups with *All conditions*, *Any condition* or *Exactly one condition*, and groups and conditions can be nested and negated. Each parameter gets a matching input, e.g. a date field, a tag selector or the object selector for IDs.

Active facet filters open in the builder as conditions, and a simple filter goes back to the facet pills when you're done. The rules are shown in your language with Gramps Web API v3.24.

Implemented in #1506

## Backups

The admin settings have a new **Backups** section. You can **create, download and delete backups** stored on the server, and **restore** from a stored backup or an uploaded file. Before restoring, you choose what to restore (data, tree settings and users) and get a preview of the changes. The restore from a Gramps XML file moved into the same upload, so the Danger Zone now only contains "Delete all objects". Managing backups needs a new permission and Gramps Web API v3.24.

Implemented in #1544

## Linked Sign-in Methods

If your server uses single sign-on (OIDC), you can now **link and unlink sign-in methods** under Settings > Account, e.g. to sign in to an existing account with Google or Microsoft. Part of #770, implemented by @scotCW in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1547

## Other New Features

* In edit mode, a person without media shows a profile picture placeholder with a menu to upload or select a media object, and the first image in the gallery is marked as the profile picture. Closes #1414. Implemented by @lukasganster in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1525
* When another task is already running on the tree, e.g. an import or a reindex, starting a new one now shows a clear message and the running task with its progress. Finished tasks in the notification log read "Task completed" or "Task failed", and clicking a failed task shows its error. #1535
* When the limit for media archive exports is reached, the error message now shows the configured limit. #1534
* The first-run wizard no longer asks for the e-mail settings, which are set in the server configuration. By @scotCW in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1511

## Bug Fixes

* Fix editing the place type, and show an error when saving an object fails #1527 (closes #1526)
* Stop sending keys back to the API that Gramps doesn't store #1557
* Fix Safari VoiceOver only reading the header row of object lists (closes #1560)
* Fix a display glitch of the map slider on mobile
* Keep long place names inside the map tooltip by @giang17 in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1548 (closes #1540)
* Keep the colour menu of the fan chart above the selected person chip by @lukasganster in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1537 (closes #1531)
* Keep the selection after reordering in editable lists by @giang17 in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1553 (closes #1549)
* Use the same age precision for personal and family events by @giang17 in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1554 (closes #1366)
* Keep object views in the selected language after a direct page load by @giang17 in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1556 (closes #1555), and reload them after changing the language #1564
* Keep tag colors readable on the dark theme by @giang17 in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1565 (closes #1310)
* Show tag colors from Gramps desktop correctly by @giang17 in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1567 (closes #1566)

## Other Changes

* Clarify the license as AGPL-3.0-or-later by @anthonyroussel in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1562
* Fix README formatting and wording by @dhruvatr in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1551

## New Contributors

* @lukasganster made their first contribution in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1537
* @giang17 made their first contribution in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1548
* @dhruvatr made their first contribution in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1551

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/compare/v26.10.1...v26.10.2
